description: This file defines the Test::Coocook class, a Perl module providing testing utilities for the Coocook application, including email handling, configuration reloading, and web interaction methods.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A Perl class providing testing utilities for the Coocook application, including email handling, configuration management, and web interaction methods.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the Test::Coocook class, initializes the testing environment and sets up the application schema and configuration.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and logs request and response details if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: emails
methods.description: Returns the list of email deliveries captured by the test transport.

methods.name: clear_emails
methods.description: Clears the stored email deliveries and resets the email count.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Removes and returns a specified number of email deliveries from the stored list.

methods.name: email_count_is
methods.description: Asserts that the number of stored email deliveries matches the expected count.

methods.name: local_config_guard
methods.description: Creates a guard object that restores the original configuration when it goes out of scope.

methods.name: reload_config
methods.description: Reloads the application configuration, either as an instance or class method.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema associated with the application.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Simulates a successful user registration process in tests.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Simulates a failed registration attempt, expecting an error matching a regex.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds a URL in the first email matching a regex and performs a GET request on it, optionally checking the response status.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Checks if the first email body matches a regex.

methods.name: email_unlike
methods.description: Checks if the first email body does not match a regex.

methods.name: _email_un_like
methods.description: Internal method to perform email content matching or non-matching assertions.

methods.name: _get_email_body
methods.description: Retrieves the body of the first stored email.

methods.name: is_logged_in
methods.description: Asserts that the client is logged in by checking page content.

methods.name: is_logged_out
methods.description: Asserts that the client is logged out by checking page content.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login action with given credentials.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs a login and asserts success.

methods.name: login_fails
methods.description: Performs a login and asserts failure.

methods.name: logout_ok
methods.description: Performs a logout action.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes the display name of the user and asserts success.

methods.name: request_recovery_link_ok
methods.description: Requests a password recovery link and asserts the process.

methods.name: create_project_ok
methods.description: Creates a new project and asserts success.

methods.name: checkbox_is_on
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox is checked.

methods.name: checkbox_is_off
methods.description: Asserts that a checkbox is not checked.

methods.name: _checkbox_is_on_off
methods.description: Internal method to check checkbox state.

methods.name: input_has_value
methods.description: Checks that an input element has a specific value.

methods.name: json_is
methods.description: Asserts that the response content is equal to an expected JSON structure.

methods.name: redirect_is
methods.description: Asserts that a GET request to a URL redirects to an expected location with a specific status.

methods.name: reload_ok
methods.description: Performs a reload of the page and asserts success.

methods.name: robots_flags_ok
methods.description: Checks the 'robots' meta tag for specific flags.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Asserts that the response status code matches the expected value.

methods.name: status_like
methods.description: Asserts that the response status code matches a pattern.

methods.name: submit_form_fails
methods.description: Submits a form expecting failure (status 400).
